notes_for_editor: Brief checked: FFLA lists Zion Hill as Tower Gone, Jasper County, 30.83719, -93.97072, and tnlandforms gives the same coordinates; no correction needed. The THC marker (HMdb 136878) gives 30 deg 50.196 min N, 93 deg 58.271 min W, about 80 m from the tower coordinates by my calculation. No source ties the tower to the church, and the story says so. The agency line on the Central US Lookouts list is one unofficial entry, so no agency is put in facts. The 'TFS' tag on the tnlandforms entry is not explained on the page text read. No build, height, staffing, fire or fate record found in the sources read or in two searches. Confidence low.
